name: update_learnings
description:
Appends a new learning or insight to the project learnings log in agent memory.
Use when: discovering a useful pattern, solving a tricky bug, or capturing a decision rationale that should inform future sessions.
Scope: local filesystem (learnings.md in memory dir). No network access.
Not for: saving full session context (use memory_checkpoint), tracking milestone progress (use update_milestones).

learning.description: The insight or learning to record. Be specific and actionable.

source.description: Optional context — where or how this was learned. Example: 'PyGithub 2.x migration'.
